sentences.text: Two Hominenteromicrobium mulieris strains, CIP 112194 and CIP 112527, were isolated from the feces of a healthy young adult from France who had a vegetarian diet.
They were obtained by species-targeted sorting using flow cytometry under anaerobic conditions, in a human gut microbiota dominated by obligately anaerobic bacteria.
A new strain of the genus Hominenteromicrobium, designated YB328, was isolated from the faeces of patients who responded to PD-1 blockade and augmented antitumour responses in mice.
That strain activated tumour-specific CD8 positive T cells through stimulation of conventional dendritic cells, which migrated to the tumour microenvironment after exposure in the gut.
